systems.platform: Community Health Toolkit (open source), customised by Medic
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène Publique; implemented with Medic, Muso and a committee of NGOs
systems.tiers: community health workers on tablets; launched March 2023 in Ségou as a national system, with 2,000 tablets distributed at launch on top of 26,000 from partners

note: Medic's story of one community health worker in Ségou using DISC-Mali; a community system only, with nothing on facility reporting or a patient record held by a facility.
